10 The prayer in the Writ Petition is to grant a No Objection Certificate for building permit (Assembly Buildings) from the Department of Fire and Rescue Services, Government of Kerala. 
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that subsequent to the filing of the Writ Petition, he was granted the NOC. Nothing survives to be considered in this Writ Petition, the same is accordingly closed as infructuous. 
The writ petition was filed seeking permission to conduct a marriage in the auditorium in question. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the same has become infructuous. Accordingly, the same is dismissed as infructuous. 
W.P.(C).No. 19345 of 2021 & connected cases The writ petition was filed seeking permission to conduct a marriage in the auditorium in question. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the same has become infructuous. Accordingly, the same is dismissed as infructuous. 
This Writ Petition is filled by claiming a deemed licence under the provisions of the Kerala Municipality Act. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prayers in the Writ Petition have also become infructuous. Accordingly, the same is dismissed as infructuous. 
The prayer in this Writ Petition is to process Ext.P1 application submitted by the petitioner seeking a D&O licence from the Corporation for carrying out the activity in the building in question. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the Corporation submitted that the application could not be processed on account of the arrears of property tax payable by the owner of the building. 
In view of the interim order passed in W.P.(C). No. 22542/2024 dated 25.06.2024, the demand raised by the corporation was stayed, on the petitioners remitting an amount of Rs.4,00,000/-
within one week W.P.(C).No. 19345 of 2021 & connected cases from the date of the order. Both sides submit that the said amount was paid on 03.07.2024. Under such circumstances, there will be a direction to the Corporation to consider the application preferred by the petitioner for a trade licence within three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment. 
The prayer in this Writ Petition was a declaration that the petitioner is not required to take any separate licence for approval in view of the registration certificate granted for Micro Small and Medium Enterprises. 
In view of the judgment in W.P.(C). No. 24342/2023, no further orders are required in this Writ Petition. 
Babu.C.P vs The State Of Kerala on 24 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116894880/
11 Accordingly the same is closed as Infructous. 
This Writ Petition was filed seeking permission to conduct a wedding on 14.06.2024. This Court had declined the interim relief by order dated 13.06.2024, but the petitioner conducted a function,
which led to this Court passing an order on 18.07.2024 imposing a cost of Rs.1,00,000/-. 
It is submitted by the petitioner that the said amount was paid on 23.07.2024. 
In view of the above, I am not inclined to proceed further in this writ W.P.(C).No. 19345 of 2021 &
connected cases petition, and the same is accordingly closed.
W.P.(C).Nos.9621/2023 and 30964/2023 These Writ Petitions are filed by persons residing in the neighbourhood against the conduct of an auditorium by the Writ Petitioner in the other cases,
complaining that the auditorium functions without a licence and other clearances for the statutory authorities. 
Learned counsel for the petitioners in the connected cases, namely the person running the auditorium submits that he has obtained all other licences except the trade licence from the Thrissur Corporation which was withheld for not paying the property tax due. In view of the direction in W.P.(C) 24342/2024, no further orders are required to be passed in W.P. (C), 30964/23 and 9621/23 and accordingly, they are closed. It will be open to the petitioners in these cases to approach the authorities in case the auditorium is run in violation of the law. 
Subject to the above, the Writ Petitions are closed. 
This Writ Petition is filed by the owner of the building in question challenging the stop memo against the construction. It is submitted by the learned Standing Counsel for the Thrissur Corporation that the construction is over, and the building has already been regularised. This is recorded. 
W.P.(C).No. 19345 of 2021 & connected cases In view of the above, nothing further remains to be considered in this writ petition. Accordingly, the same is closed. 
This Writ Petition is filed by the owner of the building challenging the consequential order passed by the Kerala Electricity Board threatening to disconnect the electricity connection granted to the auditorium. This was issued as a consequence of the issuance of the stop memo by the Corporation. 
Since the construction is already over and regularised, nothing further survives for consideration in this Writ Petition and the same is accordingly closed.
